deviations.what: Omitting video section, fun facts counters, best deal tabs, and booking form
deviations.why: Required removals: counters without evidence, urgency 'HURRY!', and booking flow not supported by Vitrina data contract. Video section lacks corresponding data field and was not part of required identity list.

deviations.what: Property card price replaced with static label 'Επικοινωνήστε' instead of numerical price
deviations.why: No price field available in Vitrina data contract for property listings; using a structural Greek label preserves the accent-colored element without inventing prices.

deviations.what: Specs line (δωμάτια/μπάνια/εμβαδόν) shows placeholders '—' instead of real values
deviations.why: No corresponding data fields exist; placeholders preserve the visual structure without faking data.

deviations.what: Category badges in property cards use gallery item's 'sub' field as label
deviations.why: Adapting existing data to the visual badge concept without inventing categories.

notes: Faithful port of Villa Agency template to Vitrina stack, preserving layout, typography, accent color, card grid, featured section, and dark contact zone. All colors routed through spine variables. Shared components integrated correctly. Contrast issue addressed by darkening --vt-accent-ink.
